X:2 is a… more condensed transcription of the preceding transcriptions !

Thanks to the op for the dots, but his transcription is from my point of view unnecessarily complicated : for example this waltz has only 2 parts but the transcriptions presents 4 parts, the last 2 being the same as the first 2 ! And the the other setting does not appear in the alternate settings section.
So I tried to simplify this, and the way the 2nd time can be written from the very same notes of the original 1st transcription.

Waltz Of The White Lilies, X:3

I believe the band recorded this tune on Eb instruments/tuning so the actual key is A. I transcribed it into A using X2 version, also trying to make it more (keyed) flute friendly.
